The '''Shrikaansi Reconnaissance Company''' was a recon [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] unit that specialized in hostile environments. The [[Geranite/Legends|Geranite]] [[Che'nash]] was a member of the unit, and the unit worked for the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Battle of Ilum]].
